name: Tool Return
query:
SELECT
    TR.name AS "Document No:Link/TMS Tool Return:150",
    TR.posting_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    TR.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150",
    TR.customer_name AS "Customer Name:200",
    TR.branch AS "Branch:150",
    TR.cpc_component AS "CPC Component:150",
    TR.machine AS "Machine:150",
    TR.operation AS "Operation:150",
    TRI.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:150",
    TRI.item_name AS "Item Name:200",
    TRI.physical_tool_code AS "Physical Tool Code:150",
    TRI.actual_tool_life AS "Actual Tool Life:120",
    TRI.qty AS "Qty:Float:100",
    TC.condition_name AS "Condition:150",
    TRI.removal_reason AS "Removal Reason:200",
    TR.returned_by AS "Returned By:150",
    TR.received_by AS "Received By:150"

FROM `tabTMS Tool Return` TR

INNER JOIN `tabTMS Tool Return Item` TRI
    ON TRI.parent = TR.name

LEFT JOIN `tabTMS Tool Condition` TC
    ON TC.name = TRI.tool_condition

WHERE TR.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s

ORDER BY
    TR.posting_date DESC,
    TR.creation DESC;
